repo.meaning: Path in a Git worktree. The resolved worktree root must exist and its basename match [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,99}; a privileged call requires owner custody.

message.meaning: Nonblank commit message and pull request body. The first line becomes the title. NUL is refused.

branch.meaning: Unused new branch name accepted by git check-ref-format --branch and not starting with a hyphen. Omitted or null generates a UTC timestamped thyrsus branch.

payload.meaning: The staff bounds its complete stdin read to 65536 characters; that is not a per-field limit.

observed.meaning: Null before worktree observation; otherwise confirms the worktree was resolved.

could-change.meaning: Native action list; empty before the operation is selected.

attempt.meaning: Ordered native step rows, not the common synthesized attempt object.

ok.meaning: Step outcome; null while dispatch is not confirmed.

final.meaning: The stop’s own final summary, beside the front door’s final_receipt.

mutationPerformed.meaning: The same mutation observation as the top-level field.

timestamp.meaning: UTC timestamp added by the staff receipt emitter.

host.meaning: Hostname added by the staff receipt emitter.

mutationPerformed.meaning: True after a branch is created or work is staged; false again after successful empty-proposal cleanup.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class when the front door catches an unhandled stop exception.

pr_url.meaning: URL set only after rereading the open pull request and confirming its head.

http_status.meaning: Forgejo HTTP status when captured for a refusal.

git_status.meaning: Git exit status when a push fails and the status is known.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Native input, configuration or operation signal. The stop can also name an unknown required field of a different loaded envelope seat.
